LESSON: KUSOMA: HADITHI

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.24: Kusoma: Hadithi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma: Hadithi. Soma kwa makini, angalia mifano, kisha fanya mazoezi na jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kusikiliza hadithi ya mwalimu ili kuimarisha stadi za kusikiliza na kusoma
2. kusoma hadithi kwa mtiririko ufao ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma
3. kufahamu hadithi aliyosoma na kusomewa ili kuelewa ujumbe katika hadithi
4. kuchangamkia kusoma hadithi ili kuendelea kujenga stadi ya kusoma. akisoma hadithi husika kwa ufasaha kisha aige usomi ule. alizopewa kuhusu lishe bora. Sarufi:Matumizi ya hiki na hivi 69 (Vipindi 2) katika kuimarisha mawasiliano kijiti?
5. kutumia hiki na hivi katika sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
6. kusoma vifungu vinavyojumuisha hiki na hivi katika kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kusikiliza hadithi ya mwalimu ili kuimarisha stadi za kusikiliza na kusoma
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kusikiliza hadithi ya mwalimu ili kuimarisha stadi za kusikiliza na kusoma. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. kusoma hadithi kwa mtiririko ufao ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kusoma hadithi kwa mtiririko ufao ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. kufahamu hadithi aliyosoma na kusomewa ili kuelewa ujumbe katika hadithi
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kufahamu hadithi aliyosoma na kusomewa ili kuelewa ujumbe katika hadithi. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. kuchangamkia kusoma hadithi ili kuendelea kujenga stadi ya kusoma. akisoma hadithi husika kwa ufasaha kisha aige usomi ule. alizopewa kuhusu lishe bora. Sarufi:Matumizi ya hiki na hivi 69 (Vipindi 2) katika kuimarisha mawasiliano kijiti?
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kuchangamkia kusoma hadithi ili kuendelea kujenga stadi ya kusoma. akisoma hadithi husika kwa ufasaha kisha aige usomi ule. alizopewa kuhusu lishe bora. Sarufi:Matumizi ya hiki na hivi 69 (Vipindi 2) katika kuimarisha mawasiliano kijiti?. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

5. kutumia hiki na hivi katika sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutumia hiki na hivi katika sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

6. kusoma vifungu vinavyojumuisha hiki na hivi katika kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kusoma vifungu vinavyojumuisha hiki na hivi katika kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Mfano 1: Asubuhi shuleni, salimu mwalimu: “Shikamoo.” Mwalimu atasema: “Marahaba.”

Mfano 2: Sikiliza hadithi fupi kisha mweleze rafiki yako jambo moja ulilosikia.

Mfano 3: Andika sentensi tatu kuhusu familia yako ukitumia maneno mapya.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Kusoma: Hadithi.
2. Explain Kusoma: Hadithi to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma: Hadithi.
4. Show that you can: kusikiliza hadithi ya mwalimu ili kuimarisha stadi za kusikiliza na kusoma
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA (MAZOEZI / MAREKEBISHO)

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma: Hadithi. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Kusoma: Hadithi important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU 8: KUMBUKA

1. kusikiliza hadithi ya mwalimu ili kuimarisha stadi za kusikiliza na kusoma
2. kusoma hadithi kwa mtiririko ufao ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma
3. kufahamu hadithi aliyosoma na kusomewa ili kuelewa ujumbe katika hadithi
4. kuchangamkia kusoma hadithi ili kuendelea kujenga stadi ya kusoma. akisoma hadithi husika kwa ufasaha kisha aige usomi ule. alizopewa kuhusu lishe bora. Sarufi:Matumizi ya hiki na hivi 69 (Vipindi 2) katika kuimarisha mawasiliano kijiti?

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
